zh-Hans: 拜托了，86！现在只能靠你这颗心脏了！
en: Come on, 86! Your engine is all I can count on now!

zh-Hans: 太危险了，我也能做到吗？
en: This is crazy. Can I do it too?

zh-Hans: 从这里再往上逼，就是赌命了。这感觉真让人发麻！
en: Pushing any harder from here means risking my life. I can feel it burning through me!

zh-Hans: 都到这一步了，我不想输！无论如何都要咬住！
en: I've come too far to lose! Whatever it takes, I'll stay with him!

zh-Hans: 在这里被甩开，就绝对追不上了。撑住！
en: If I fall back here, I'll never catch him. Hold on!

zh-Hans: 终点已经近了！在这里被甩开，就再也没有机会了！
en: The finish is close! If he pulls away here, I won't get another chance!

zh-Hans: 这家伙太厉害了……来了个不得了的对手！
en: This guy's incredible... I'm up against something really dangerous!

zh-Hans: 真难缠，毫无疑问，这是至今最危险的境地！
en: He's tough. No question, this is the deepest into the danger zone I've ever been!

zh-Hans: 话说回来，我是不是开始累了？
en: Come to think of it, am I getting tired?

zh-Hans: 开始摸清这条山路的节奏了。
en: I'm starting to feel this pass's rhythm.

zh-Hans: 能行，已经能按自己的节奏跑了！
en: I can do this! I'm driving to my own rhythm!
I'm feeling it now. I'm counting on you, 86!

zh-Hans: 不客气了，百分之百全力跑！
en: No holding back. A hundred percent, all out!

zh-Hans: 我想赢。头一次这么强烈地想赢。
en: I want to win. I've never felt it this strongly before.
